::: {#exm-temperature}

#### Drawing at three temperatures

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
temperatures = [0.5, 1.0, 1.5]
draws = [sample(lm, prompt, 1000, temperature=t) for t in temperatures]
shares = [real_word_share(d) for d in draws]
print(shares)
# The prose below says the share falls as the temperature rises,
# from most of the words at the lowest to under half at the highest.
assert shares[0] > shares[1] > shares[2]
assert shares[0] > 0.5 > shares[2]
print(draws[0][:200])
print(draws[2][:200])
```

| [Temperature](#def-temperature) | Share of drawn words found in the training text |
|--:|--:|
| `r py$temperatures[[1]]` | `r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * py$shares[[1]])` |
| `r sprintf("%.1f", py$temperatures[[2]])` | `r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * py$shares[[2]])` |
| `r py$temperatures[[3]]` | `r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * py$shares[[3]])` |

At temperature `r py$temperatures[[1]]` most of the network's words are ones it has seen.
At `r py$temperatures[[3]]` most of its words are not in the training text,
and the spelling breaks down.

:::
